steps.title: Why it matters for Windsor-Essex
steps.text: [Harmful algal blooms are a concern for our region because Lake Erie is an important source of drinking water, recreation and economic activity. Wind and water conditions can move blooms toward the Windsor-Essex shoreline and Pelee Island, potentially affecting drinking water sources and beaches. Some blooms produce microcystins, toxins that can pose health risks to people and animals. Blooms also create concerns for fishing, as eating fish caught in affected waters may pose health risks. These impacts make monitoring Lake Erie essential for protecting local communities, public health and the regional economy. | https://www.wechu.org/your-environment/beaches | https://www.essexregionconservation.ca/programs-services/watershed-health | https://www.wechu.org/your-environment/blue-green-algae-bloom]
